text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Kita-chan, find anything you wanted?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Teio-san, is there anything you 
particularly need—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Aaah! Teio! It's Teio! Let's battle, 
battle meee!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what's with you all of a sudden? 
...Then again, you're always popping up 
out of nowhere, Turbo.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. Oh, Kitasan is here too! Then 
you're battling too, Kitasan!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh... wait, a battle? What kind of 
battle...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
If we're going for a run somewhere, I'd 
love to join in...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. That sounds super fun too, of 
course, but—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, I win! You're a million years too 
early to beat me at a dance game!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah!! No fair, no fair! Turbo is good at 
dancing too, you know!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: More importantly, were you okay just now?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you really not hurt anywhere!? You 
took a massive tumble!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo is super tough, so I'm fine!! Thanks 
for helping me out!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh, not at all! I was right next to you, 
so it was the natural thing to do!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
But 'cause of that, Kitasan lost points... 
Ugh... I'm sorry!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Turbo-san... it's totally okay! It's not 
like this was our last match!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! I'll take on your challenge 
anytime, hop!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Mm, perfect! And that makes another win 
for me~♪

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Whyyyy!? When Turbo took a shot, the ball 
flew all the way over to the next table!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Even I was shocked by that one. Good thing 
it didn't hit anyone.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It happened so fast, but I'm so 
relieved I managed to catch it mid-air...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, thanks! Is your hand okay? Does it 
hurt?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm completely fine! Something like that 
is nothing to me.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Still... to think she's even amazing at 
billiards. Teio-san really is 
incredible...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(A horse girl who shines not just in 
races, but in all sorts of different 
things...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(I want to become a horse girl like that 
too!)

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
See ya later! Let's battle again 
sometime!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, full of energy as always.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, by the way, Kita-chan! Thanks for 
today!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Eh?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You covered for everything I couldn't 
reach in time, right? So, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Th-That was just by chance! I just 
happened to be standing close to 
Turbo-san...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Even so, your reflexes were insane, and 
you looked super cool!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well! You're still pretty far from 
matching my level of cool, though!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, ! To get praised by Teio-san just 
for doing something so ordinary...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You can be way more confident, Kita-chan! 
Because who knows... one day, you might 
even—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Teio-san?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Heheh. Never mind♪ Keep working hard, 
and feel free to chase after my back as 
much as you want!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Y-Yes! I'll keep chasing after you 
forever!
